basic_info.description: Perched on a large lot below the quaint Poppy Lane, 82 Sussex is a Glen Park gem with stunning views, magnificent natural light, and endless charm. This detached cottage-style home boasts open-beam ceilings that create an airy, expansive feel.   It offers a spacious bedroom with large windows on two sides, plus a bonus flex room and bath belowideal for storage, home office, gym or creative space. The inviting living area features a wood-burning fireplace, engineered wood flooring and southern outlooks. The updated kitchen is open and boasts new appliances. The dining room off the kitchen has direct access to the back deck and yard.    Freshly painted and new carpet in two rooms, this home is move-in ready. Surrounded by a massive garden, it is a true urban retreat perfect for relaxing or entertaining. With in-home laundry and potential parking off Poppy Lane, this home combines practicality and comfort with classic charm.  What a location - in the heart of one of San Francisco's most treasured neighborhoods, just minutes from Glen Canyon Park's scenic trails and Rec Center, BART, and the vibrant Glen Park Village. There is a parking pad in the back yard accessible via Poppy Lane, a dirt alley in the back. The gate would need to be enlarged along the back fence.
